propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py) has zero live callers after bug 3b5f removed the producer and all dispatch arms.

Deletion is safe because the port's stated purpose (same-pass re-creation) was already ruled out by a prior operator decision, and the outbound probe chain (deletion detection in _apply_outbound_probe and binding_walk) is separate and remains live.

The port must be deleted outright rather than re-homed to binding_walk because re-homing would re-split ownership boundaries ADR 0028 deliberately consolidates, and the vocabularies are incompatible (ProbeBranch lacks a confirmed-404 branch and conflates deletion with MOVE).

Deletion leaves orphaned config keys (jira.resolved_statuses, reconciler.resolved_statuses, DC transport _resolved_statuses) that are deferred to a follow-up ticket for deprecate-vs-remove decision, making this change behavior-neutral.

A semantic search and string grep both confirm zero production call sites outside the port surface itself; two stale docstrings claiming by-path loads of inbound_probe.py are false positives to be corrected.
